title: Would this explanation survive a review?
description: Change the estimator, reference cohort, and sample budget. Watch the attribution map, fidelity, repeatability, and release verdict move together.

methods.label: Exact TreeSHAP
methods.detail: Use a compatible tree model and its structure to compute additive values without sampling noise.
methods.limitation: Exact computation does not settle the semantics of dependent features. Different valid background or dependence assumptions can still produce different attributions.

methods.label: Sampled SHAP
methods.detail: Estimate coalition contributions through repeated model queries when an exact specialized method is unavailable.
methods.limitation: Sampling variance and background choice both matter. Pin the seed for reproduction, but validate across several seeds before trusting a ranking.

methods.label: LIME surrogate
methods.detail: Fit a weighted sparse model to perturbed examples around this one prediction.
methods.limitation: The result describes the fitted neighborhood, representation, kernel, and sparsity settings. It is not an additive decomposition of the black-box prediction.

cases.label: Credit limit review
cases.detail: A reviewer needs to understand a model score before deciding whether to investigate or request more evidence.

references.label: Full training population
references.detail: Compares the applicant with the population used to fit the model, including unlike products and risk bands.

references.label: Matched product peers
references.detail: Compares the applicant with similar customers using the same product and application channel.

references.label: Recent market cohort
references.detail: Compares the applicant with recent applications after a pricing and underwriting policy change.

cases.label: Payment fraud review
cases.detail: An investigator needs a bounded explanation for a high-risk transaction without exposing detection rules to the customer.

references.label: All scored payments
references.detail: Compares the transaction with all payments, including different merchants, regions, and customer histories.

references.label: Merchant and region peers
references.detail: Compares the transaction with payments at similar merchants in the same operating region.

references.label: Recent approved traffic
references.detail: Compares the transaction with recent payments that cleared investigation and settlement.

cases.label: Subscription retention
cases.detail: A product team wants to understand a low retention score before designing an intervention experiment.

references.label: All subscribers
references.detail: Compares the account with the full subscriber training population across plans and lifecycle stages.

references.label: Same-plan peers
references.detail: Compares the account with customers on the same plan and at a similar lifecycle stage.

references.label: Recent renewal cohort
references.detail: Compares the account with customers who reached renewal after the latest product release.
